verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud markets understanding production systems "using natural language" and ships AI features including Grafana Assistant and Investigations. Its knowledge graph surfaces insights with "no complex queries required." However, no evidence shows a natural-language question returning a real PromQL/LogQL query or a generated chart, and these features appear to be Cloud-only marketing claims. Missing for 10: documented NL-to-query/NL-to-chart behavior, coverage for self-hosted OSS Grafana, in-depth docs for Grafana Assistant, independent or hands-on corroboration.
